assets.label: barraca de tecidos e cerâmicas
assets.brief: A freestanding night-market stall, weathered dark timber posts, luxurious crimson cloth awning with subtle gold edge and small gold flame pennant, wooden counter with neatly stacked red/gold woven fabrics, ceramic jars, one warm hanging lantern. Tasteful believable materials, modest ornament, readable simple silhouette. Entire stall isolated, not attached to a building.

assets.label: palmeiras e jardim desértico
assets.brief: A beautiful small desert garden cluster: two natural date palms at slightly different heights, detailed curved fibrous trunks and graceful green fronds, restrained low flowering desert shrubs around a low sandstone planter, two small terracotta pots. Realistic volumetric foliage with cool lunar edges, subtle amber light from a tiny lantern at planter base. Not polygonal or toy-like. Full foliage and base visible. One isolated reusable vegetation cluster.

assets.label: arcada de passagem

Flat walkable stone lintel above rounded arch, believable 3D volume, complete two pillars and arch, no surrounding buildings or floor.

assets.label: casa com varanda de madeira

Same premium material detail as approved reference. Orthographic front view, no people.

assets.label: módulo de aqueduto
assets.brief: A complete monumental sandstone AQUEDUCT MODULE, three open arches with genuinely transparent openings, thick stone piers and flat horizontal water channel along top. Small visible turquoise water stream in top channel, warm lantern on a pier and one restrained crimson gold flame banner. Side elevation, believable water-carrying infrastructure. No detached floating rocks, no sky, no surrounding landscape. No waterfall reaching off canvas.

assets.label: fonte dos jardins do oásis
assets.brief: An elegant OASIS FOUNTAIN module: low wide carved sandstone octagonal basin, one smaller tier supported at center, gentle turquoise water spilling into basin, modest flowering green desert plants at base and small brass lantern. Match kingdom motifs with a discreet gold flame medallion. Transparent area around and above fountain. Premium volumetric water and weathered stone; no broad pool or landscape.

assets.label: ruínas e colunas antigas

Transparent opening under arch. Restrained archaeological architecture sharing the kingdom materials, hints of sand and weathering on individual blocks. No mountains, no cave background, no giant floor.

assets.label: guindaste e transporte de minério
assets.brief: A complete primitive MINING GANTRY module: believable weathered dark timber posts and crossbeam with iron brackets, working rope pulley and hook holding one ore crate, one separate small four-wheeled mine cart loaded with rock at base, amber hanging lantern. No modern engines or modern machinery. Side-on front elevation, mechanically coherent structure for a medieval desert mine, everything inside canvas. No rails extending beyond image.

assets.label: portão militar de controle
assets.brief: A complete MILITARY CHECKPOINT GATE: two sturdy sandstone guard piers with warm small lanterns and long crimson banners bearing elegant gold flame insignia, heavy reinforced timber double gate visibly OPEN inward leaving a transparent passage between piers, a flat stone lintel and modest crenellations above. No giant city behind it. Clearly defensive yet restrained, no spikes placed on playable floor.

assets.label: entrada monumental da mineradora

Opening is dark tunnel interior, background around outer rock silhouette transparent. No whole mountain, no scenery. Front elevation, arch shape differs from urban gate.

assets.label: ponte de madeira e pedra
assets.brief: A complete horizontal TIMBER BRIDGE MODULE for a medieval desert mining route: flat sturdy walking planks, timber trestles below with iron brackets and cross braces, restrained rope handrail BEHIND walking line, one small amber lantern on far end support. No stairs, no ladders, no floating disconnected planks. Straight SIDE ELEVATION, top beam remains visibly flat across frame. Entire structure isolated, no terrain or gorge painted behind.

assets.label: minérios e cristais subterrâneos

Believable geology, restrained soft luminous crystals not a giant explosion. Grounded side elevation with transparent background; no cave walls or scenery, no interface pickups or coins.
